name: Guangzhou Huayan Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Huayan Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd. is an international supplier specializing in PET preform systems. The company engineers and delivers a variety of advanced equipment, including injection molding machines, robotic take-out units, and intricate valve-gated hot-runner molds designed for PET preforms. Their extensive product line also features complete injection molding systems, various PET preform molds, and associated mold components. These solutions are vital for packaging across numerous industries, such as beverages, water, edible oils, general food items, detergents, and medical products. Founded in 2002, the company's operations are based in Guangzhou, China.
